topics.label: Introduction to Inflammation Dynamics
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and outlines how previously learned immune components are integrated in the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Principles of Innate Immune Recognition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system detects infection and cellular damage by distinguishing foreign or damaged molecular patterns from self.

topics.label: Pattern Recognition Receptors and Inflammasome Signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine specific receptor families and intracellular signaling complexes that transduce microbial and danger signals into inflammatory responses.

topics.label: Acute Inflammatory Cascade and Physiological Consequences
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the execution and physiological impact of the acute inflammatory response across local tissues and the wider circulatory system.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation and Tissue Repair
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how tissues recover from inflammation and how the body adapts when complete resolution cannot be achieved.

topics.label: Conclusion and Next Lecture Preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on the complement system.
